summary: Ridgetech Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting the adoption of its Sixth Amended and Restated Memorandum and Articles of Association, approved by shareholders at the August 25, 2026 annual general meeting. The charter amendment creates Series A Preferred Shares and revises general meeting quorum to one-third of voting power. The document was filed with the Cayman Islands registry on August 27, 2026. This is a routine corporate governance update, not a special situation. No transaction terms, premium, or strategic event are present. What to watch: potential future issuance of the new preferred shares, though not announced.
